mechanism: St. John's wort induces CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, reducing piroxicam metabolism and increasing its serum concentrations, while also potentiating NSAID-related GI bleeding risk through additive antiplatelet effects.
action: Monitor for signs of piroxicam toxicity and GI bleeding; consider alternative herbal product or adjust NSAID dosing; counsel on increased GI ulceration risk.
